title: lava db:rollback --json
description: Undoes the last N batches, newest migration first. The unit is the batch, not the migration: 'undo the last deploy' is the question, and it has an answer that does not depend on remembering how many migrations that deploy contained.

rolled_back.description: The migrations undone, in the order they were undone — newest first, the reverse of the order they were applied. Empty when there was nothing to do, or when the run was refused before undoing anything.

batches.description: The batch numbers those migrations came from, highest first — derived from what actually came off, not from what was asked for. So a run refused part-way reports the batches it touched, and `rolled_back` and `batches` always agree.
